title: Rational points over global function fields from homogeneous characteristic-zero lifts over complete mixed-characteristic DVRs with relative Picard rank one and universal torsors
author: Jason Starr; Chenyang Xu
work: Rational points of rationally simply connected varieties over global function fields
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.65
difficulty_reason: The new argument specializes rationally connected Hilbert-scheme pseudosections through Esnault finite-field point theory and Abel torsors, linking characteristic-zero rational simple connectedness to rational points in positive characteristic.
